meta.name: checkpointed-agent-loop
meta.description: Run long or failure-prone Claude Code tasks as bounded, resumable loops with a durable state machine, attempt budget, and verification evidence checkpoint.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让长任务可断点续跑并控制尝试次数
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常跑耗时长、易失败的AI编码任务
copy.tagline_en: Run long tasks as resumable loops with attempt control
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run long and failure-prone AI coding tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把长任务拆成一步步的小循环，每一步都记录在本地检查点文件里。这些循环设有尝试次数上限，做一步就验证一步，验证通过才标记成功。中断后新会话可读取记录继续，不用从头再来。
howto.when: 当 Claude 接手可能被打断、需要限次重试，或必须证明验证已通过才能算完成的任务时，它会启用检查点循环。典型场景包括迁移、重构、测试修复等跨会话工作。

say.text: 这个数据库迁移可能跨多个会话，请用检查点循环来管理，最多重试3次。
say.note: Claude 会初始化检查点并设置尝试预算。

say.text: 先记录下一步计划，然后进入验证，只有证据通过才能标记成功。
say.note: 会按状态机推进，未验证不会算完成。

say.text: 如果验证失败，返回重试状态并给出具体修复动作和原因。
say.note: 重试会消耗一次尝试，超限后停止。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs long tasks as bounded, resumable loops with a local checkpoint file. Each attempt is verified; success requires passing evidence. New sessions resume from saved state.
howto.when_en: Use when a task may be interrupted, needs bounded retries, or must prove verification before completion. Typical cases include migrations, refactors, and test repair spanning multiple sessions.

say_en.text: Manage this DB migration with a checkpoint loop, max 3 retries.
say_en.note: Claude initializes a checkpoint and sets the attempt budget.

say_en.text: Record the next plan step, then verify; only mark success if evidence passes.
say_en.note: Moves through the state machine; unverified work won't succeed.

say_en.text: If verification fails, rerun with a concrete next action and reason.
say_en.note: Each retry consumes an attempt; the loop stops when the budget is exhausted.
